column1: # semantic-delta-catalog burn-down. Copy to semantic-delta-catalog.tsv at repo root and fill in.
# Tab-separated. Lines starting with # are comments — strip before machine-parsing.
#   pending  delta identified, not yet swept
#   swept    grep/ast-grep run, ZERO hits on the changed surface (one closing row per delta)
#   hit      occurrence found, not yet pinned  <-- GATE FAILS while any row is 'hit' or 'pending'
#   tested   pinned by a test that FAILS under the wrong (target) semantics
#   waived   provably safe; one-line reason lives in the pinning-test column
#   n/a      delta does not apply to this language/version pair
# delta-id references references/language-deltas.md (PG-* Python->Go, GG-* Go version/Go->Go).
